description.en: Used sensitivity alone as the answer, treating it as if it were the same thing as positive predictive value and ignoring prevalence entirely.
description.et: Kasutas vastusena ainult tundlikkust, käsitledes seda nagu see oleks sama, mis positiivne ennustusväärtus, jättes levimuse täielikult arvestamata.

description.en: Used specificity in place of sensitivity in the numerator, confusing the two distinct properties of the test.
description.et: Kasutas lugejas tundlikkuse asemel spetsiifilisust, ajades segi testi kaks erinevat omadust.

description.en: Divided sensitivity times prevalence by prevalence alone, omitting the false-positive contribution from the healthy majority entirely.
description.et: Jagas tundlikkuse ja levimuse korrutise ainult levimusega, jättes valepositiivse panuse tervest enamusest täielikult välja.
